result.rationale: Mild activity-related wrist soreness without injury, numbness, or weakness supports self-care (rest, ergonomic breaks, ice/heat, splint). The FDA card applies: at 24 weeks, ibuprofen and other NSAIDs should be avoided unless a clinician specifically advises; acetaminophen is the usual first-line option per pregnancy guidance, and she can confirm with her prenatal provider. No clinician assessment task is needed now; escalate if numbness, weakness, swelling, or worsening pain develops.
